# VariantReach

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Stats` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed record VariantReach
```

How far one variant's edit reaches: the share of the collection that carries it, and, when the book states a target supply, the expected number of assets.

## Remarks

The figure is [`RarityCalculator`](Nfty.Core.Stats.RarityCalculator.md)'s `OverallPercent`, the number the Ingredient pane already prints, so the two cannot disagree. An expected count is never exact, hence the `~`.

- `RecipeHasRules` (`bool`) - Whether the variant's recipe has incompatibility rules, which can shift the real share away from the weights.
